name: feature-loop-codex
description: Codex-native feature development loop on top of acceptance-gate with installable role-based custom agents, model-aware budget routing, evidence-backed verification, human gates, and no Claude Code workflow scripts. v1.12 adds Pareto carry-forward (P1 delta-scoped staleness reverify, P2 baseline-once, P3 judge-panel memo) — same trust bar, run-log is the only memo. v1.13 adds the CT-S coverage switch: T2/T3 default-on morphological-scan of the AC space at S1, a required contract Coverage section gating Gate 1, and card-rendered coverage evidence — skipping requires a visible descope entry. v1.14 adds the S1 step-8 clean-context gap-probe (spawned worker, probe-failed non-blocking) rendered on the Gate-1 card. v1.17 adds S4 scope-triage: every confirmed review finding is classified against the contract (in-contract / out-of-contract / unclassified) by one fresh agent, a high in-contract finding drives REJECT so the machine fixes what the contract already bounds, out-of-contract findings never enter the fix list and go to Gate 2 for the human to decide, triage failure fails toward the human (no finding may drive a REJECT), and two or more findings in files no eval covers raise a widen-or-narrow cluster flag. v1.18 adds cross-feature claim index (Claude harness only — Codex parity deferred, see descope ledger); v1.18.1 hardens the claim-scan parser. v1.19 adds the platform-fit gap-probe cross-check and mandatory feature_loop.ui_standards_skill loading at S1; design-pass S1-D wiring stays Claude-only for now (descope ledger d-20260730T050548Z-4723). v1.20 makes every plan or progress summary presented to a human load the human-facing-language reference through the plugin resolver (this package does not ship it, so joining it onto the package root is a dead pointer) and render with PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE — MỌI lần trình, not only the T3 plan-review stop. v1.21: câu về hình trong vòng lặp chép nguyên văn khuôn LOOP-PICTURE-CLAUSE, chọn cách vẽ theo mặt phẳng đang trình. v1.22 adds the one-lane re-pin ritual (REPIN-TEMPLATE marker mold: one fresh machine-lane per re-pin event, N per-slug {"kind":"repin"} run-log lines sharing one run_id, machine-enforced by pre-merge/recheck — missing line, sha mismatch, nonzero suites_exit or missing run-log are VIOLATIONs; old-form sections grandfathered) and fix-round P1 carry (invokedSha stamps every run-log line; scripts/carry-plan.mjs computes the carry matrix with atomic-pair; no sha in history → full rerun, the safe default). v1.23 adds the measurement review lens (finder #3 `measurement`: six defect shapes single-sourced in MEASUREMENT_SHAPES, mutation-covered, findings flow through the standard refute/scope-triage path) and the measurement cross-check block in the S1 gap-probe prompt of both harnesses (full-matrix / positive-control+pinned-message / hand-written-fixture / round-trip-from-real-writer / vocabulary-vs-relationship / instructions-vs-output / hardcoded-ROOT — answered from evals.yaml expected fields). v1.24 closes the judgment loop with judge-required-evidence: the workflow's VERDICT_SCHEMA carries required_evidence, panel memo lines and P3 carry preserve it per-vote, and the fix round after a judgment FAIL must READ required_evidence and supply exactly that evidence first (guessing is forbidden while the list exists) in both harnesses. v1.25: this package now ships carry-plan.mjs itself (machine-pinned by P162 — the instructions may only reference tools the package carries), and carry-plan's fail-open is closed: --delta-files is required, unknown flags explode, skipping delta needs an explicit --no-delta. v1.26 adds the stop-patching law (STOP-PATCHING-CLAUSE marker mold in both harness instructions, behavior-scored by role-play runs): a second fix round still producing same-class defects means the solution frame is wrong — STOP and present the human three paths instead of dispatching round three. v1.27 adds the measure-birth law (MEASURE-BIRTH-CLAUSE marker mold in both harness instructions at S3 + an S1 eval-plan pointer, backed by the measure-birth.md reference mold in acceptance-gate ≥ 1.39): a NEW measure only counts as done when it ships with a two-direction case pair on one fixture — positive control green, break-the-real-object red with a pinned message. v2.0 (ceremony diet — reset charter): gate minutes become optional and are never asked, the human-side KPI switches to human-touch frequency counted from git, sign-batch.mjs signs a whole batch with ONE human-run commit, and re-pin moves to a per-release campaign. Evidence standards unchanged. Full human-facing changelog lives in CHANGELOG.md at the root of the acceptance-gate-kit repository — installed packages do not carry that file (this description stops growing from 2.0.0 on).

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native feature loop with acceptance gates
interface.longDescription: Use Feature Loop Codex to guide a feature from idea through design, acceptance contract, evals, implementation, role-routed custom agents, deduped machine verification, judgment panels, adversarial review, evidence-backed human signoff, and handoff using Codex-native orchestration instead of Claude Code workflow scripts.
